text:
alex: Heads up — customer-facing ingestion alerts didn't page the on-call. Incident-bot posted to #incidents but I see no pages going out. Anyone get paged?
oncall-tim: I didn't get a page. I was on call and my phone is silent.
sre-bot: Incident created INC-5233. Paging attempts returned 429/401 from notify-proxy; attempts queued.
maria: 429/401 combo during paging window? We had a secret rotation earlier. Did notify-proxy pick up the new webhook token?
ops-ellen: I rotated the notify webhook token in Vault yesterday and marked it deployed. Did someone redeploy notify-proxy?
carla: Vault shows the new token, but notify-proxy env is still using the old token (checked pod env). Looks like it hasn't been restarted since rotate. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
alex: That would explain auth failures. Why did monitoring not escalate when pages failed?
maria: Code path: incident-bot suppresses retries for auth errors. See snippet: 
```
if response.status_code == 401:
  suppress_retries = True
  log.info("auth failure, suppressing retries")
```
So failures were swallowed, and no manual escalation fired.
alex: Great, suppression + rotated secret = silent paging. We need manual escalation now. @oncall-tim please call CS and start customer impact check.
oncall-tim: Calling CS now, will report back in ~10m.
deploy-bot: Deployment recorded: 2026-03-17T11:02 by carla -> notify-proxy v2.4.3 (no restart since token rotate).
carla: I didn't trigger a restart after rotating the token — I assumed secrets mounted via CSI would pick up. My mistake.
ops-ellen: Rolling restart of notify-proxy now. Will patch secret mount and restart to pick up new token.
sre-bot: Paging resume check: first attempt after restart returned 200 to pager service. Will keep monitoring for 15m.
oncall-tim: CS confirmed a handful of customers saw delayed alerts, no data loss. CS filing follow-up tickets for affected accounts.
maria: For a hotfix: incident-bot should NOT suppress retries on 401. Instead surface auth errors to #incidents and trigger manual escalation.
alex: Agree. Also add a runbook verification step for secret rotations. Who picks up the hotfix?
carla: I'll open a PR to change retry/suppression logic and add clearer logs in notify-proxy. I'll also add a readiness probe that checks token acceptance. Assign to me.
alex: Also temporarily add a manual escalation rule: any 4xx from notify-proxy should page SRE if automated retries fail.
ops-ellen: Manual escalation policy added. Monitoring alert for notify-proxy 4xx now routes to SRE and on-call paging.
sre-bot: Incident closed INC-5233 — duration 32m. Root cause: secret rotation + retry-suppression bug.
alex: Please write a postmortem. @maria @carla @ops-ellen to own sections. Include timeline and customer impact.
carla: I'll draft the technical root cause and PR links.
maria: I'll take timeline + monitoring gaps.
ops-ellen: I'll document process changes for secret rotations and escalation rules.
oncall-tim: Thanks team. Ping me when the postmortem is up so I can update CS and the customers. :thumbsup:
